_doc: Music Ed Cafe merch (preorder reservations, no payment). Edit and rebuild. price: null shows 'Price TBA' and leaves the Offer out of the JSON-LD; set a number (e.g. 28) once it is known. eta: null shows 'Pressing soon', or set a short text like 'Ships in December'. status: 'preorder' takes reservations; anything else shows the item without the form. options[].values are the only values the server accepts. image: base name of the files in assets/static/img/merch/ (<image>-480.webp, -960.webp, -800.jpg).
